purpose: Compact source-snapshot and payload-custody manifest for public frontier refs whose bulky/dynamic payloads are not generally vendored; route-bearing placements require typed source-role events and explicit no-promotion caps, while selected small public text payloads and compact checksum manifests may be retained with local SHA-256 replay, including declared upstream checksum-manifest anomalies when the upstream file hash itself is exact.
non_promotion_rule: Source-snapshot rows are locators, checksum/inventory records, and custody checks only. They do not promote routes, upgrade evidence units, or substitute for acquired payload replay.
